use_case_summary: Real-time agent assist for live contact center agents. Core functionality: token-streaming suggestions, short-form reply generation, inline KB retrieval, and tool-calling to create/escalate tickets. Non-functional requirements: end-to-end SLO for suggestion delivery <= 150ms median under normal load, 95th percentile target <= 300ms; sustain bursts up to 1,000 concurrent agent connections with graceful degradation (fallback to cached templates or smaller model). Must support structured function/tool calling, signal provenance/confidence, redact PII at generation time, and provide audit logs for compliance. Preference for dedicated VMs with VPC peering or on-prem appliance for residency-sensitive workloads.
decision_criteria: Latency SLO met in dedicated POC, security + KMS integration validated, predictable unit cost under bursts, ease of integrating tool-calls with existing ticketing API. If POC passes, target enterprise pilot Q3.
